# The game's unit and biped hooks, quiet deaths, flight, surfaces, melee, speech and equipment
# (tools/engine_unit_life_reference.py).
# hook <function> -> <changed|unchanged> (the fake world's bytes after the call)
# kill <silent> <damage flags> -> <damage flags after>
# air <type> <damage flags> <definition flies> <airborne ticks> -> <unit flying> [<biped flying>]
# disconnect <support> <pathfinding> <last pathfinding> -> <each after>
# stop_melee <biped> <melee ticks> -> <melee ticks after>
# speaking <priority> -> <speaking>
# equipment <equipment> -> <current equipment>
# relaxation -> <maximum relaxation iterations>
